Parking the roadmap. Nothing gets handed off. Stage 1's finding stays on record for whoever resumes this, and the open work goes to the deferred backlog where it can age normally.

**What parks:** 1 of 2 stages complete.

| Item | Size | Done when |
|---|---|---|
| Stage 2 — Closure notices (O5, Track B) | small: one closure-log poll every 10 minutes | the notice job and its operator mailing list exist, and in a test an email reaches every address on the list within an hour of a new closure entry |
| O2 — 7-day closure-risk outlook per lock | small: one model run a day, on top of Stage 1's 22-minute fit | each lock has a 7-day closure-risk outlook from the river-level forecast |
| O3 — Pooled per-lock curves for all 14 locks | about 14 × 1.8 GB, from Stage 1's data volume | separate closure curves exist for all 14 locks, pooled across locks |
| O4 — Closure-history map for boat operators | about a day: one static map page | boat operators have a closure-history map of the canal |

Each item will point to `specs/lock-closures-stage-1-findings.md` (3.1 m threshold, 22 min / 1.8 GB). O2 and O3 build on that finding, so it stays in `specs/`. There's no spec, methodology or critique file to retire alongside the roadmap.

**Steps, in order:**

1. `Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/references/deferred-backlog.md` to get the exact Deferred-item schema. The four items above get reshaped to fit it.
2. `Read specs/deferred_items.md`, if it exists, so I append to it and never overwrite it.
3. `Edit specs/deferred_items.md` to append a `## lock-closures-roadmap — 2026-11-07` section holding the four items, each self-contained, with `Size:` and `Done when:` as above.
4. `Edit specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md` to add, under the header, `PARKED (2026-11-07) — 1 of 2 stages complete. Reason: the canal study's funding ended.`
5. `Bash: mkdir -p specs/completed && git mv specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md`
6. `Bash: git add specs/deferred_items.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md && git commit -m "Park lock-closures roadmap (1 of 2 stages complete): funding ended"`. This is a local commit on `main`, with no push.

Two notes:

- The session started under 2026-11-06, but the environment date is 2026-11-07, so I've used 2026-11-07. Say if you want the earlier date.
- My environment reports this directory as not a git repo. If step 5 or 6 fails for that reason, I'll do the move with a plain `mv` and tell you the commit didn't happen.
